rationale: Conceptually sound and aligned with MISEV/rodent precedent, but critical experimental validations are missing. Key evidence gaps: no demonstration that spike‑in tracers and immuno‑capture reliably recover low‑biomass nasal lavage/CSF/olfactory‑mucosa samples; unproven detergent+protease specificity (may destroy non‑EV mediators); capture‑depletion feasibility for particle‑matched arms; and lacking stability/yield/lot‑comparability and scale‑up data. These validations are required before the proposed in vivo→ex vivo bridging experiment can be meaningfully tested or interpreted.
